answer: The jetty counter is kept in summit and inlet exposes each reset. An attacker thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 40 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 40 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3932 identities would post 2575 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
